entries.surface: Mounted Builder Feature meanings > Interpretation > Reusable mappings

operation.variant: derive and save reusable revision from a configured column

request.apply: The library revision is saved by this request; it does not mutate the configured feature. A later review/apply is a separate operation.

gates.when: context is ready and the saved column resolution is READY
gates.effect: Only applicable library heads are offered and save is enabled.

gates.when: column.interpretation.pinned is absent
gates.effect: Pinned features show explanatory text and disable revision creation.

dynamicProvider.property: libraries filtered to READY resolution.applicableRevisionIds and head

constraints.statement: A new library ID or an applicable existing library head plus a non-empty trimmed explanation is required; a created revision remains unapplied to the column.

invariants.statement: Revision creation is scoped to the saved output/column and current snapshot/draft identity, and the UI says the feature remains unchanged until review and apply.

independent_preview_apply.apply: Saving creates only a reusable library revision; feature application is a separate candidate review/apply action.

model_binding.statement: Mode, library ID, and explanation bind to createInterpretationRevisionFromColumn request fields; current feature binding is unchanged.

entries.surface: Mounted Builder Feature meanings > Interpretation > reusable mapping Review / Apply

operation.variant: preview an exact applicable revision for one column, then apply its candidate receipt

gates.when: column context resolves READY and the revision is an applicable library head
gates.effect: Review request is sent for the selected output, column and exact revision ID.

gates.when: review request returned ready result
gates.effect: Apply is offered with the candidateReceiptId and revisionId returned by that review.

constraints.statement: The full-output-exhausted versus sample-only state is rendered from review response completeness; a bounded row review is not represented as proof about a full output.

invariants.statement: Apply uses the exact candidate receipt and revision returned by the review for the same output/column; stale review state is cleared when draft identity changes.

independent_preview_apply.preview: Yes; explicit Review creates a candidate preview with limit 100.
independent_preview_apply.apply: Yes; explicit Apply sends APPLY_INTERPRETATION_CANDIDATE only after a ready review.

model_binding.statement: Preview is bound to the selected output, column, draft and revision; apply binds the returned candidate receipt and revision to that same column.

entries.surface: Mounted Builder Row setup > Starting collection > PopulationPanel
path: Use selected resources / Replace current collection

operation.variant: attach a selection revision to the current output through one compiler-returned route choice, or replace its attached revision

gates.when: a current selection revision is loaded
gates.effect: Route lookup is keyed to output, snapshot and selection revision, and options are response-derived.

gates.when: selection resource type matches table root resource type
gates.effect: Direct same-resource route can be selected and is surfaced separately from other connections.

dynamicProvider.property: choices[] filtered and transformed by populationRouteOptions

constraints.statement: The current attached collection remains attached until the user explicitly replaces it; route choices come from the server response and selection/output/snapshot identity is checked before use.

invariants.statement: The panel exposes only compiler-returned population route choices; it reports no supported path when no choice exists and does not invent route edges.

independent_preview_apply.preview: No user-triggered candidate preview; selection attachment is a direct command and automatic preview/reconciliation belongs to lifecycle inventory.

model_binding.statement: Command binds outputId, active selectionRevisionId and one response-provided routeChoiceId.

entries.surface: Mounted Builder Row setup > Starting collection > PopulationPanel

operation.variant: remove the attached selected collection and use the authorized output rows

gates.when: table.document.population exists
gates.effect: Clear control is shown only when a collection is currently attached.

constraints.statement: Clearing is an explicit user action labelled Use all authorized rows; it is not triggered by loading a different selection revision.

independent_preview_apply.preview: None; direct command and automatic preview/reconciliation are lifecycle-owned.

model_binding.statement: Clear command targets the selected outputId.

entries.surface: Mounted Builder Row setup > Starting collection > PopulationPanel

operation.variant: check selected-resource coverage for the current receipt and attached selection

gates.when: receiptId, attached population and current selection exist, and attached.selectionRevisionId equals current selection.id
gates.effect: Coverage button is shown/enabled only for the matching selected collection and receipt.

constraints.statement: The response is rejected as stale unless receipt, output, selection revision, generation, scope digest, membership digest and resource type match the active scope.

invariants.statement: An incomplete coverage response is shown as incomplete and the UI does not present its partial rows as exact coverage counts.

independent_preview_apply.preview: No candidate preview or apply; this is a read-only coverage check.

model_binding.statement: Request binds receiptId/outputId; result is additionally checked against the active selection identity.

entries.surface: Mounted Builder Row setup > Starting collection > PopulationPanel coverage report

operation.variant: create an excluded selection revision, preserve the attached route, then attach the variant

request.routeLookupConstructor: BuilderWorkspace.excludePopulationMember -> LoomClient.searchPopulationRoutes, paging until the same saved route is found

gates.when: coverage status is COMPLETE, response has unmapped resource refs, and attached route is uniquely identified
gates.effect: Only reported unmapped members expose Remove from collection.

constraints.statement: After creating the exclusion variant, the client searches until it finds the same route; it reports failure rather than attaching if no matching route is returned.

invariants.statement: The source selection is immutable: exclusion creates a new revision from the attached selection with the chosen member excluded, then attaches that new revision.

independent_preview_apply.preview: No independent candidate preview; selected-resource coverage is the evidence leading to the exclusion action.
independent_preview_apply.apply: Attaches the new selection variant with SET_TABLE_POPULATION.

model_binding.statement: Variant is derived from the exact active selection revision and one returned ResourceRef; route lookup must match the prior saved route.

entries.surface: Mounted Builder Row setup > Starting collection > PopulationPanel member list

operation.variant: review removal of one attached selection member and apply its proposal

gates.when: attached selection equals current active selection and current draft/snapshot identity exists
gates.effect: Member list and proposal flow are mounted only for the exact attached selection/current output scope.

constraints.statement: Selection pages are checked for exact signed selection identity, completeness, duplicate/out-of-scope members and total member count; proposal response is checked against the same output, draft, selection and removed member before preview/apply.

invariants.statement: Removal is a two-step action: Review removal obtains a proposal preview; the user must explicitly Apply member removal. A failed apply reports the accepted collection is unchanged.

independent_preview_apply.preview: Yes; removal proposal preview has limit 25 and is shown before user apply.

model_binding.statement: Proposal request binds current snapshot/draft/output/base selection and one exact member; response proposalId applies against the same output.

entries.surface: Mounted Builder Add Columns > Coded > Manage saved coded-value sources > FrameSourcePanel

gates.when: table has frames and Add Columns is in coded view
gates.effect: The panel mounts to manage saved coded sources.

gates.when: the selected existing frame has coded-value columns
gates.effect: Replacing/removing the frame requires explicit Apply this change after warning that the listed columns will also be removed.

dynamicProvider.property: sources[] excluding already used source identities
forms[] supported by this source choice

constraints.statement: Replacing or removing a source that owns columns requires explicit confirmation; confirmation warns those columns are also removed.

Creation of a new frame source is not reachable from this mounted instance: BuilderWorkspace passes allowNewSource=false, while this instance is mounted only when saved frames exist. The onSet callback is supplied but no current-panel control invokes it.

invariants.statement: The active replacement route is bound to the currently edited frame ID; this Builder mount does not expose the new-source SET_FRAME_SOURCE path.

independent_preview_apply.preview: Replacing/removing a source with owned columns has an impact confirmation, not a data candidate preview. Selecting coded-value categories follows the existing add-columns proposal/preview workflow.
independent_preview_apply.apply: Explicit Apply this change for impacted source replace/remove; direct command for unreferenced source or column removal.

model_binding.statement: Active controls bind to saved frame IDs and returned source choice IDs. onSet/SET_FRAME_SOURCE is passed but hidden by allowNewSource=false in this mounted route.

gates.when: configured row represents a construction output rather than an authored column
gates.effect: Name and table visibility are available; filter, chart and remove controls are intentionally absent for construction output rows.

dependsOn: configured authored column or construction output

constraints.statement: Column names are trimmed and empty names are rejected by restoring the prior label; table visibility/order applies to authored columns and constructed outputs through distinct UPDATE commands.

invariants.statement: Visibility, labels and ordering change table presentation metadata; they do not change the authored row definition or construction operation.

independent_preview_apply.preview: No independent preview; presentation changes are direct commands and automatic preview refresh is lifecycle-owned.

model_binding.statement: Authored column presentation binds to columnValue; construction output presentation binds to stepId, columnId, label and table metadata.

gates.when: ColumnSelector occurrenceId is not base
gates.effect: The Count and Yes / no shortcuts are shown for this related occurrence.

constraints.statement: These two shortcuts create aggregate sources directly; they do not use the construction-choice candidate proposal workflow or select a scalar related field.

independent_preview_apply.preview: No independent candidate preview; the new aggregate column is submitted directly and automatic preview refresh is lifecycle-owned.

model_binding.statement: The command binds the selected output and occurrence, aggregate source kind and operation, and derived display title.

entries.surface: Mounted Builder PreviewTable > Columns > Cohort member values
path: One unique value / All unique values

operation.variant: change output value cardinality policy for an explicit-group row value binding

gates.when: column has a columnId, is a base-occurrence field, supports the current transformation and is bound in GROUPS with EXPLICIT row source
gates.effect: Only then does PreviewTable render the cohort member policy control.

constraints.statement: This output-side setting is separate from ADD_COLUMNS construction-choice rowValuePolicy; it edits one existing explicit-group row-value binding by authored physical column.

independent_preview_apply.preview: No independent candidate preview; direct command and automatic preview refresh are lifecycle-owned.

model_binding.statement: Request binds outputId, authored column name and one ONE/ALL policy.

entries.surface: Mounted Builder ColumnSelector > configured authored column FeaturePolicyEditor

gates.when: configured column resolution maps to exactly one capability candidate
gates.effect: Candidate-driven filters, chart flags, operation choices, temporal and unit controls are derived from the returned capability; unavailable recoding preserves a remove-saved-recoding path where present.

gates.when: candidate provides available temporal reduction with valid timestamp and anchor paths
gates.effect: Date selection/window apply remains disabled until both selected paths belong to the returned capability and lookback is a nonnegative safe integer.

dependsOn: more than one unique advertised mode

dynamicProvider.property: aggregateOperations[] filtered by current rowContext and source path

dependsOn: candidate.valueTransformations exact-category or coded-value capability available

constraints.statement: Operations and temporal/unit choices are capability-derived and some legacy/fallback options remain visibly described as requiring Loom validation; this UI evidence does not establish backend acceptance or semantic correctness.

invariants.statement: Source and policy edits submit through explicit Builder commands and are scoped to the selected output and authored column; client capability filtering is not a backend conformance promise.

independent_preview_apply.preview: No candidate preview/apply workflow in these configured-column editors; saved commands cause lifecycle-owned refresh.
independent_preview_apply.apply: Direct UPDATE_COLUMN_SOURCE, SET/CLEAR_COLUMN_CONTRIBUTOR or UPDATE_COLUMN_TRANSFORMATION command.

model_binding.statement: Column feature policy is encoded in source, contributor or transformation fields on the selected authored column; all provider-backed choices are UI-restricted to current context.

operation.variant: load exact source descriptor for one configured column

gates.when: user selects Column details on a configured row and output exists
gates.effect: The inspector is loaded for that authored column; response must identify the same column.

constraints.statement: A source descriptor returned for another column is rejected before display; Edit in graph is a local mode/occurrence selection action.

independent_preview_apply.preview: No candidate preview; this read displays returned source/route facts.

model_binding.statement: Source inspection binds snapshotToken, outputId and one authored column name.

entries.surface: Mounted Builder PreviewTable row identity, source and owner-record details

variants: show row identity and attached single source locally
page composite row contributors when lineage capability is AVAILABLE

gates.when: preview row has COMPOSITE source and preview.rowLineageCapability.status=AVAILABLE
gates.effect: Opening its identity panel starts contributor lookup; later pages use returned nextOffset.

constraints.statement: A row without a nonempty identity has no identity-inspection button; unsupported or incomplete lineage is reported as unavailable/incomplete rather than complete.

invariants.statement: Lineage requests are receipt/output/row bound and fetch 25 contributors per page; owner-record cell inspection reads the preview value locally without a separate lineage request.

independent_preview_apply.preview: No candidate preview/apply; source inspection reads the current preview receipt.

model_binding.statement: Lineage request binds preview receiptId, outputId, rowId, offset and fixed page limit.

path: focus responsible Builder setting / Close review

operation.variant: summarize saved row/column definitions, compile shapes, reductions, preview evidence and diagnostic issues; navigate to responsible setting or close

request.panelRequest: DatasetReviewPanel itself makes no API or authoring command request. Opening Review may call lifecycle-owned reconcileCurrent when a current receipt is missing or reconciliation is unresolved.
request.navigationRequest: None; local review visibility, feature mode, selected table/occurrence and focus state changes.

gates.when: reviewOpen is true
gates.effect: The panel is mounted. Receipt and preview are passed only when the receipt includes every current output ID.

dynamicProvider.provider: review target synthesized from saved state/diagnostic target resolution

dependsOn: blocking issue has a mapped target
reconciliation state and matching receipt output

constraints.statement: Panel text explicitly says this review summarizes saved definitions and compiler evidence and does not establish clinical correctness or machine-learning readiness; preview evidence explicitly does not validate the complete population.

invariants.statement: Focus actions route the user into the responsible table, row setup, or column editor without issuing an authoring write from the review panel itself.

independent_preview_apply.preview: Review displays already supplied compile/preview results; opening may trigger lifecycle reconcile if results are missing/stale, covered by builder.automatic_preview_refresh_and_recovery.
independent_preview_apply.apply: None in DatasetReviewPanel; row/column edit occurs after navigation in its owning editor.

model_binding.statement: Review items are derived from current saved tables, catalog, receipt, preview, diagnostics and reconciliation state; focus targets carry the exact output/column/occurrence where available.

variants: toggle display of disconnected catalog nodes
inspect node/edge and select query occurrence locally

request.viewState: showOrphans and isExpanded are local React state; ReactFlow node/edge inspection updates local inspection and may dispatch selectOccurrence. Route/root writes are mapped separately to existing canonical contracts.
request.endpoint: None for view toggles or inspection alone.

gates.when: BuilderWorkspace selects GuidedGraphWorkspace and disabled is false
gates.effect: Graph node/edge inspection is enabled; route-edit buttons are separately restricted by legal route helpers and lifecycle state.

constraints.statement: The graph is non-draggable and non-connectable; actual route edits are invoked only through explicit callbacks and legal edge filters.

independent_preview_apply.preview: No data candidate preview for view-state changes; route/root authoring preview is owned by lifecycle/row-change contracts.

model_binding.statement: Orphan visibility, graph expansion and inspection do not bind to persisted authoring state.

entries.surface: Mounted Builder ColumnSelector and PreviewTable configured-column removal

gates.when: ColumnSelector row kind is configured authored column
gates.effect: Remove button is exposed for that configured column; construction output rows do not expose removal in ColumnSelector.

constraints.statement: Configured-column removal is an immediate REMOVE_COLUMN command; the configured-column editor does not expose a separate confirmation or candidate preview.

independent_preview_apply.preview: None; automatic preview refresh is lifecycle-owned.

model_binding.statement: Removal binds one authored column name to selected outputId.

operation.variant: filter configured/available column rows by case-insensitive substring

request.constructor: input onChange -> local setQuery; normalizedQuery filters currently loaded rows
request.endpoint: None; no API request or authoring command

gates.when: a catalog occurrence is selected
gates.effect: Search field is shown; search matches local row label/name/source text or candidate label/path/logical type.

constraints.statement: Search is a local, case-insensitive substring filter over rows already built from configured columns, current construction outputs and available catalog candidates; it does not request more data.

independent_preview_apply.preview: Not applicable; local row filter only.

model_binding.statement: Search query is transient React state and is not saved to the Builder draft.

surfaceMappings.surface: ColumnSelector available candidate rows and select-all action

dependsOn: candidate.filterable or chartable gates for FILTER/CHART

surfaceMappings.mappingEvidence: The existing canonical ADD_COLUMNS catalog field operation is reused; this mapping adds the mounted ColumnSelector affordance and its initial presentation domain, without duplicating the operation entry.

surfaceMappings.surface: ColumnSelector configured Filter toggle and available Add as filter control

request.constructor: Configured filter toggle uses onChange -> UPDATE_COLUMN; candidate add uses ADD_COLUMN with initialPresentation FILTER

dynamicProvider.provider: resolved candidate.filterable; configured row currently defaults to true if no capability candidate resolves

surfaceMappings.mappingEvidence: The control only configures filter presentation; predicate operators and filter values belong to the separate KEEP_ROWS filter editor.

visibleButDisabledIntentions.control: Use as filter / Add as filter
visibleButDisabledIntentions.when: available candidate is not filterable, or configured column is not filterable and its current filter flag is absent
visibleButDisabledIntentions.effect: Control is visible but disabled; an already configured filter can still be turned off.

operationVariants: ADD_COLUMN choices via existing addSelectedFeatures proposal/apply workflow

request.addConstructor: CategoryPicker.addColumns -> BuilderWorkspace.addSelectedFeatures -> construction-choice proposal and apply

dynamicProvider.property: entries[] matching frameId, rowRoot, outputId, query and current cursor

surfaceMappings.mappingEvidence: Frame category add is already represented by the semantic ADD_COLUMNS proposal/apply family; this mapping captures the frameId-specific mounted route.

visibleButDisabledIntentions.when: category has no selectable executable construction-choice option for this frame.form
visibleButDisabledIntentions.effect: Category is rendered with an unavailable message and its selection checkbox is disabled.

surfaceMappings.surface: PreviewTable Columns > Split values into rows

request.detail: Existing relational entry owns proposal/preview/apply path; this mapping records only the PreviewTable entry point.

surfaceMappings.mappingEvidence: Preserve the relational owner's existing status and operation path for builder.reshape.expand_scalar_list; do not duplicate that entry here.

surfaceMappings.surface: PreviewTable row-limit select and DatasetReviewPanel open/reconcile entry
operationVariants: open dataset review; reconcile if current receipt/reconciliation is unresolved

request.detail: Preview limit updates the identity consumed by useAutomaticPreview; no independent submit button. Dataset review's conditional reconciliation is lifecycle-owned.

surfaceMappings.mappingEvidence: The preview and reconciliation execution is lifecycle-owned; this supplemental surface mapping records the input and review trigger without duplicating the lifecycle contract.

surfaceMappings.surface: GuidedGraphWorkspace current traversal, graph nodes/edges, RouteExtensionPanel

request.routeBounds: Only edges returned by legalOutgoingEdges or replaceableIncomingEdges are selectable; parent routeActions source owns exact bounds.

surfaceMappings.mappingEvidence: Reuse lifecycle canonical route/occurrence ID; no separate graph-specific mutation contract is created. The graph presentation/local inspection state is separately inventoried as builder.guided_graph.view_state.

operationVariants: select replacement root node and enter row-change assessment/preview path

request.detail: Existing lifecycle canonical root-change assessment/proposal/preview/apply path owns requests.

surfaceMappings.mappingEvidence: Reuse the existing root-change canonical ID; this row records the graph entry point only.

surfaceMappings.surface: ColumnSelector Select all table columns / Deselect all table columns
operationVariants: bulk ADD_COLUMN with initialPresentation TABLE when available candidates exist

request.constructor: ColumnSelector.toggleAllTableColumns -> presentation callback for configured visibility, then onAddAll for available candidates
request.detail: Visibility writes reuse builder.column.presentation; available candidates reuse builder.add_columns.catalog_field.

dependsOn: configured or construction output rows currently in occurrence scope

surfaceMappings.mappingEvidence: Maps the bulk presentation half of this control to the canonical column presentation entry; the same button also adds currently available catalog fields through the canonical add-columns entry.
